page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on external storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests which fall into the bottom 25 percent, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to deliver average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached read and write operations remains in the average tier.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core execution, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads such as software compilation, database operations, and static web serving. It also handles moderate LLM inference tasks for small and medium models at average speeds. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile offers a stable, dedicated resource allocation for general-purpose enterprise applications that require consistent multi-core processing without needing high single-threaded clock speeds or local NVMe storage.
